; but Roses, Geraniums, Heliotropes, Verbe-nas, Daphnes, Azaleas, &c., must be near the glass, and under the direct influenceof the light, if we would have them flourish. An exposure where the sun canstrike unobstructed from its first appearance above the horizon in the morning,until one or two oclock, p. m., is much the most desirable.
